name: Hero Split
description: Split hero with a bold headline, subcopy, dual CTAs and stats on one side and a code-window mockup on the other.
usage: Import HeroSplit and drop it at the top of a landing page: <HeroSplit headline="Clean code, warm coast." accentWord="warm coast." primaryCta={{ label: 'Start a project', href: '#contact' }} />. Or paste section.html into any Tailwind page. Both default to realistic saltycodestudio content.
